result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a wide multi-lane roadway with no visible sidewalks or dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. Although a traffic signal is present, the lack of marked crossings and pedestrian signals forces any foot traffic into a high-speed vehicle environment.

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways for pedestrians, forcing anyone on foot to walk on the shoulder or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no clearly visible or maintained crosswalk markings.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense trees and bushes along the roadside may obscure pedestrians from drivers' view, particularly near the curve.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide safe separation from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add pedestrian countdown signals and push buttons to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and marked crosswalks, despite being signalized for vehicular traffic. The environment is dominated by wide asphalt surfaces and dense vegetation, creating a high-exposure environment for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: No sidewalks or marked crosswalks are provided at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Significant sun glare reduces visibility for drivers approaching the intersection, increasing the risk of collisions.

interventions.title: Install Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to define pedestrian paths across the intersection.

interventions.title: Construct Sidewalks
interventions.description: Provide continuous paved walkways separated from the roadway to ensure pedestrian safety and connectivity.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide dedicated crossing phases and improve predictability.
